name: ssrs-to-sigma
description: Migrate Microsoft SSRS (SQL Server Reporting Services) reports to Sigma — RDL/RDLC report definitions → Sigma data model + workbook, with a firewall-friendly customer-side export step, RDL XML parsing, SSRS-expression translation, Tablix matrix→pivot / table→table / chart→chart mapping, parameters→controls, and a parity-verification scaffold. Honors the sibling converters' 'flag, never fake' contract: raw-SQL/stored-proc datasets, custom VB code, and pixel-perfect paginated layouts are surfaced as loud flags rather than silently mis-converted. Built from research; structurally validated against a bundled fixture. Includes a read-only estate assessment. Companion to the sigma-migration-skills converters.
